name: ortho-trim
label: Ortho Trim (mobile)
author: Whitewater Rescue Institute
description: Invisible map companion: on phones, turns off orthomosaic layers (tiled-imagery/KML overflight layers and their Drone Overflights-style groups) after the webmap loads. Visibility is flipped client-side only, so the saved webmap and desktop users are untouched and a phone user can still re-enable a layer from the Layers list.
